title: Democratic Quality Scorecard: Housing Security Anti Eviction and Urban Land Equity Bill

dimensions.evidence: Protects Article 21 right to shelter and dignity against arbitrary eviction.
Reserves 30% urban land pooling for affordable low-income housing.
Criminal penalties and reconstruction compensation for illegal demolitions.
Demolition powers subject to independent Judicial Magistrate authorization.
Mandatory 90-day written public notice and open GIS urban land allocation mapping.
dimensions.corrective_action: Physical posting and public loudspeaker notice.

dimensions.evidence: Imprisonment up to 3 years for executing unauthorized evictions.
13 languages, municipal drop-boxes, legal aid representation.
